test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

If my uncle were here now, he __knows__ what to do.
solution: The correct answer is '**would know**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The underlined part in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, '**would know**' should be used instead of '**knows**'. • The given sentence is an example of **a second conditional.** • The structure of these kinds of sentences is: • If + Subject + V2, Subject + would + V1 • Example: *If I were the king, I would reform these tax laws.* • Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.** **Correct Sentence:__** *If my uncle were here now, he **would know** what to do.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिए गए वाक्य में रेखांकित भाग व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ '**knows**' के स्थान पर **'would know' **का प्रयोग होना चाहिए। • दिया गया वाक्य **second conditional **का एक उदाहरण है। • इस प्रकार के वाक्यों की संरचना है: • If + Subject + V2, Subject + would + V1 • Example: *If I were the king, I would reform these tax laws* • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 1** है। 36:Tea9, The correct answer is '**Although**'.
